summary.en: Two to four benefit words relayed in the centre, each with its own geometry behind it: rings that spin, rings that lock, a metal sheen for the last.
summary.zh: 两到四个利益词在画面中央接力，每个词背后一套专属几何：转动的环、咬合的环，最后一个词扫过金属光泽。

fits: A three-point benefit statement (quick, locked, polished) or a set of values said one word at a time, in the middle of a film.
notFor: Words longer than one word (three Chinese characters); calm films (nothing on screen ever stops); light grounds.

intent.en: Let each benefit word be argued by its own geometry, spinning rings for quick, locking rings for tight, a metal sheen for the final word, so three words become one continuous claim rather than three title cards.
intent.zh: 让每个利益词由专属几何替它论证：转动的环是“快”、咬合的环是“紧”、金属光泽给最后那个结论词，三个词连成一句连贯的主张，而不是三张字卡。

content.en: 2–4 single benefit words of the same grammatical kind (en ≤ 9 chars each, zh ≤ 3), optional one-line subs (en ≤ 40, zh ≤ 16), and which geometry backs each word.
content.zh: 2–4 个同一词性的利益词（每个英文 ≤ 9 字符，中文 ≤ 3 字），可选每词一行说明（英文 ≤ 40，中文 ≤ 16），并指定每个词配哪套几何。

fits.zh: 片子中段的三点式利益陈述（快、稳、精致），或一词一词说出的一组价值观。

notFor.zh: 超过一个词的说法（中文超过三个字）；安静的片子（画面上始终没有静止）；浅色底。

pairs.note: the polished last word hands over to the lockup

en: The words must be the same kind (three adjectives or three comparatives) and of similar length; a long word pushes out of its ring.
Give the sheen to the last word only; sheen on every word removes the sense of a conclusion.
Keep the dust, shared stage light and progress bar; without them the relay falls back into three separate cards.
zh: 几个词要同一词性、长度相近；长词会顶出圆环。
金属扫光只给最后一个词；每个词都扫就没有结论感。
保留背景微尘、共用舞台光和进度条；没有它们接力会退回三张分开的字卡。

upstream.name: 利益词接力
upstream.summary: 三个利益词各带一套专属几何接力——虚线大圆减速自转 + 彗星弧飞跑 → 三实线圆 trim 依次生长后收拢咬紧 → 镀铬金属 sheen 扫过后一拍收成纯白；旧词缩到 0.86 淡出，新词描边→填充揭示
upstream.use: 三点式利益陈述（更快/更好/更强）；品牌价值观段落；需要"一词一世界"的中段推进
upstream.energy: 中高（三拍推进 + 全程几何运动 + 背景粒子，无静止帧）
